description_en: Queries snapshot information by calling DescribeSnapshots
name: DescribeSnapshots

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS edge zone. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637662.html to query edge zone IDs
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the specified cloud disk
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en: The snapshot ID. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照标识编码。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: The array of ENS edge zone IDs. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

parameters.help_en: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current query
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数
parameters.name: page_size
